Name: More Paint Masks
Author: atravita
Description:
Adds in the buildings not included in vanilla into the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Carpenter%27s_Shop#Painting]vanilla game's painting system[/url]. Now you can make all your buildings weird colors!

[b][size=5]FAQ[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*][b]Does this work with modded textures for buildings?[/b] Basically no, the color masks are done manually. You would have to make the color masks yourself.
[*][b]Can you adjust the color masks a bit?[/b] ... Maybe. It's pretty easy to do, btw, with just GIMP and the paintbucket tool. If there's, like, a large bit of outcry for something, I might add it, but it's easy enough to personalize it yourself. (In my laziness, I've even included the GIMP files XD)

[*][b]The slime hutch is cut off in the preview[/b] ....Yeahhhh can't do anything about that without C#, sorry.
[*][b]The fish pond water colors are awkward[/b]. It's mixed with fish-specific colors by the game so it's really hard to get a good pure color here using just the painting system.
[*][b]What about the shipping bin?[/b] Turns out only the base can be targeted by the base game painting system.
[*][b]The preview images have questionable color choices.[/b] They really are, I'm no artist, you can probably do better than me.

[/list]

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=monospace]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Uninstall[/size][/b]

[b]Un-paint every building you have painted[/b], and only then remove this mod from your mods folder.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6+ on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. For multiplayer: you should probably install on all players.
[/list]
